target.summary: applyMask treats any string matching providerReferenceRegexp (${...}) as a reference to preserve without redaction, ignoring fallback defaults. When a sensitive field uses an env provider reference with a literal default (such as ${env:NAME:-default}), the default value is left unmasked, exposing secrets in the unexpanded configuration snapshot.
